answer: Shares of Anthropic fell 8% on Tuesday, sending the stock below the artificial intelligence company's $83 IPO price [P1]. The AI lab's stock has been sinking steadily since opening at $111.50 on the Nasdaq on Thursday, after Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in the largest offering of all time [P4]. Investors eagerly awaited Anthropic's debut in hopes that the company would revitalize the broader AI trade, which has been volatile in recent weeks over concerns about the feasibility of a multi-trillion-dollar infrastructure buildout [P4].
